input_path.description: Source path and file from OpenStreetMap (.osm.pbf).

output_path.description: Target path for vector tiles. Specify .mbtiles/.sqlite or a directory.

config_path.description: Path to layer and global config file (.json).

process_script_path.description: Path to Lua processing script for processing tags.

store_dir.description: Path to the directory to use as a temporary store during processing. Empty string means use RAM.

bbox.description: Bounding box to use (minlon,minlat,maxlon,maxlat) if input file does not set one.

verbose.description: Outputs any issues encountered during tile creation.

compact.description: Reduce overall memory usage by assuming nodes are numbered sequentially.

skip_integrity.description: Don't enforce checks on all nodes being present in ways.
